title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.8 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 13.8 up to but not including 19.3.9, 19.4 up to but not including 19.4.8, and 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.6 allowed authenticated users to read NuGet package metadata without proper authorization. This issue was due to missing authorization checks and has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
